name: contracts-backend-data
objective: Align generated contracts, API gates, authorization, handlers, state machines, transactions, migrations, indexes, idempotency, outbox/inbox, jobs, media, providers, and projections for every field-related journey and surface.
truthOwner: Identity/Workforce/DSH/WLT according to canonical domain ownership; surfaces are presentation and composition only.

acceptanceCriteria: No handwritten parallel field request, response, status, or error authority remains.

tasks.rollback: Revert the stage commit or disable its governed rollout while preserving forward-compatible data and evidence; never roll back by restoring a parallel truth.
